scope: Separate annual witness-template candidate. The dated municipal notice and map localize the September closure to an exact historical OSM corridor. Admit 1,836 existing AVA road occurrences wholly clear of its 20 m exclusion buffer; hold both Uerkenbrücke–Engelplatz directions (153 occurrences). All April decisions and every prior accepted path remain identical. Full GTFS identities, coordinates, calendars and calls are preserved. These are archived trip-template counts, not date-specific regional feeds or certified running tracks.
